headline: SEA @ PIT matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SEA 4.46 at PIT 4.10, with a projected total of 8.56. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward PIT: SEA moved -0.24 runs while PIT moved -0.02, changing the projected margin by -0.22 runs. NRFI probability dropped -15.5%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: George Kirby has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Bryan Reynolds, Cole Young, Jake Mangum, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Mitch Garver, Rob Refsnyder because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
